description: Use this when the user wants to create or recover a CongressMCP account in chat. It sends a six-digit, 15-minute code to the supplied email after explicit acceptance of the terms and privacy policy. It does not start a subscription, expose whether an account already exists, or charge anything.

accepted_terms.description: True only after the user explicitly accepts https://www.congressmcp.com/terms and https://www.congressmcp.com/privacy.

email.description: Email address that will own the CongressMCP account.

name.description: Person or organization name for the account.

name: start_email_signup
title: Send a CongressMCP email verification code
